Misleading Menu Photos, Poor Service and Terrible Value
Jul 2026 • Couples
Very disappointing experience overall. We waited a long time before any of the staff acknowledged us, even though we were clearly trying to order. Communication was also extremely difficult, as several waiters could not understand even very basic English and had to call someone else to assist.

Part of our order was forgotten, and there were also mistakes on the bill, with items appearing to be charged twice. The restaurant itself did not feel particularly clean, and some of the food was served cold.

The biggest issue was that the dishes looked completely different from the photos shown on the menu. The photos were very misleading, especially considering how expensive the food was. The meat was dry, and although the seafood seemed fresh, it was bland and lacked flavour. The salad was acceptable, but nothing special.

The food was not completely terrible, but it was mediocre at best and absolutely not worth the price. For the quality of the food, the poor service and the overall experience, this place offers very poor value. I would not recommend it.
